newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index little changed.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index little changed.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was little changed, up 0.24 points, or 0.31 percent, at 78.60 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index gained 34.28, 0.99 percent, to a provisional 3,487.44 points.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 13.91 percent after yesterday's 15.97 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
